blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY, Oriental Mindoro — The Bulalacao municipal government in Oriental Mindoro is asking the Department of Agriculture to secure fuel subsidies for farmers, as a prolonged dry spell threatens crop production and the town’s water supply. On his social media page, Mayor Lumelito Cabagay posted that the local government is coordinating with the Municipal Agriculture Office, the Municipal Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Office, and barangay officials to request diesel assistance. The subsidy would help farmers operate water pumps to keep their rice fields irrigated amid dwindling water sources. READ: Provinces brace for drought, farm losses “If there is a […]...
